#!/usr/bin/env bash
# vea-task-commit.sh <task-id> <message> — commit working-tree changes on
# task/<id> (excluding the untracked .pi/ runtime dir), then restore
# fix/val-doc-1. No-op-safe: leaves the tree clean when nothing changed.
set -euo pipefail
REPO=/home/agentops/dev/vea_validators/vea
ID="${1:?usage: vea-task-commit.sh <task-id> <message>}"
MSG="${2:-task($ID)}"
git -C "$REPO" add -A -- ':!.pi'
if git -C "$REPO" diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "no changes to commit"
else
  git -C "$REPO" commit -m "$MSG"
  echo "committed: $(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --short "task/$ID")"
fi
git -C "$REPO" checkout fix/val-doc-1
echo "restored branch: $(git -C "$REPO" branch --show-current)"
